phrases.es: A stamp for this letter, please.
Have you got any envelopes?
How much is it to send this parcel?
Where is the postbox?
What's the postcode?
I want to send it first class.
phrases.note: «First class» — быстрая доставка Королевской почты, обычно на следующий день.

phrases.es: Where do I sign?
What are the opening hours?
This parcel is very heavy.
I want to send it abroad.
phrases.ru: Я хочу отправить это за границу.

phrases.es: I've got a delivery note.
Can I have the tracking number?
It's fragile.
What's the weight of the parcel?
Can I have some tape?
I need to pick up a parcel.
The parcel is in my name.
Here's my ID.
Do I need to fill this in?
When will it arrive?
I'd like to make a complaint.
My parcel is missing.
Can I pay cash on delivery?
By recorded delivery, please.
Do I have to pay customs duty?
I'd like to insure the parcel.
Can you track this parcel?
The bird isn't to blame.
It's the safest thing for now.
What if he stays at home at night?
phrases.ru: А если по ночам он будет сидеть дома?

phrases.es: Would you allow us to deliver this old letter?
phrases.ru: Вы позволите нам доставить это старое письмо?

phrases.es: Hey, will you let us take this letter?
phrases.ru: Слушай, дашь нам отнести это письмо?

phrases.es: No, a letter is delivered by hand, not by air.
phrases.ru: Нет, письмо вручают лично, а не по воздуху.

phrases.es: Let the raven take it, it will be faster.
phrases.ru: Пусть его несёт ворон, дойдёт быстрее.

phrases.es: What if the raven comes with us, and we carry the letter?
phrases.ru: А если ворон полетит с нами, а письмо понесём мы?
